"""Worst-case topology: caterpillar chains maximizing node/cell counts."""
import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev')
from harness import run, hx
import ref

G = 2730           # groups -> 8190 prefixes
fib = []
for g in range(G):
    key = (0x7000000000000000 + g)          # distinct 64-bit front keys (<=4096)
    base = key << 64
    for i in range(3):
        a = base | ((i + 1) << (128 - 124))  # differ in the level-9 chunk
        fib.append((ref.mask(a, 124), 124, g * 4 + i))
print('prefixes', len(fib), 'front64 keys', len({a >> 64 for a, l, h in fib}))
q = [fib[i][0] for i in range(0, len(fib), 97)][:800]
ops = [['put', hx(a), l, h] for (a, l, h) in fib]
ops += [['query', [hx(a) for a in q]], ['save'], ['load_saved', 0], ['image_query', [hx(a) for a in q]]]
t0 = time.time()
resp = run({'cases': [{'ops': ops}]})
t1 = time.time()
r = resp['results'][0]
img = r['snapshots'][0]
print('elapsed %.2fs loads %s rows %d cells %s bitmaps %d ni %d' % (
    t1 - t0, r['loads'], sum(len(b) for b in img['banks']), img['cells'], len(img['bitmaps']), len(img['nexthops'])))
Q = ref.make_lpm(fib)
print('live ok', r['answers'][:len(q)] == [Q(a) for a in q])
print('image ok', r['answers'][len(q):] == [Q(a) for a in q])
t0 = time.time(); ok, reason, fib0 = ref.validate_image(img, want_fib=True); t1 = time.time()
print('py valid %s %s (%.1fs) fib size %d' % (ok, reason, t1 - t0, len(fib0) if fib0 else -1))
print('stdout bytes', len(json.dumps(resp)))
PYEOF
